Reference

API reference

Find public types, protocols, and entry points.

TypePublic entry points and purpose
EthereumClientinit(chainID:rpcURL:headers:) or init(chainID:transport:), contract(at:abi:), verifyChain(), blockNumber(), receipt(for:), waitForReceipt, prepareDeployment, and both deploy overloads.
EthereumContractaddress, abi, read, simulate, estimateGas, prepareTransaction, send, execute, logs, logPages, watchLogs, and decodeLog(_:as:).
ContractABI, ContractArtifactDecode JSON. The ABI exposes signature lists. The artifact also exposes creation bytecode.
ABIValue, BlockTagSupply typed ABI values and select a block context.
EthereumAddress, Hash32, TransactionHash, UInt256, Int256Represent Ethereum primitives. TransactionHash is a typealias of Hash32. UInt256.hex is a compact RPC quantity, while bytes is the full-width word.
TransactionOptions, EIP1559Transaction, EthereumSignatureConfigure value, gas, and fees. Inspect unsigned fields and access the signing payload and digest. Represent recoverable signature components.
TransactionReceipt, EthereumLog, ContractEvent, ContractRevertInspect mined status, raw events, decoded events, and decoded revert payloads.
EventTopic, EventTopicFilter, EventWatchOptionsConfigure indexed event filters, page size, confirmation depth, poll interval, and retry limit.
EventPages, EventWatch, ContractEventPageConsume history or ongoing updates as async sequences of inclusive block ranges and decoded events.
EthereumSigner, ExternalWalletSession, ExternalWallet, WalletTransactionRequest, TransactionStateConnect signing or wallet software and observe transaction progress.
RPCTransport, HTTPTransport, RPCErrorInject an RPC transport, configure HTTP behavior, and inspect node errors.
LocalEthereumSignerThe optional SolidityBridgeLocalWallet product provides in-process secp256k1 signing.
soliditybridge-bindingsThe command-line product generates Swift source from a contract ABI or artifact.
